title: Mudstone Studios Membership
source_quote: Mudstone offers a wide variety of cone 6 clay bodies and glazes, as well as low-fire, raku-fire, and other alternative firings.
evidence_sentence: The membership page lists raku-fire as one of the firings available to members at Mudstone Studios.
summary: Monthly or drop-in membership ($175/month or $165 for 4 visits) gives 24/7 access to Mudstone's studios in Warren, Pawtucket, or Wareham with raku-fire and other alternative firing options available to members.
